description: Gates the designtwin:screen-builder subagent with the same plan check build-screen runs. Claude Code ignores `hooks` in a plugin-shipped agent's frontmatter, so the gate has to be registered here. The script reads the hook JSON from stdin (only when stdin is not a terminal, never waiting on a silent pipe), exits immediately when design/plan/ has no open plan, checks only the plans the subagent's own tool calls wrote (Write/Edit, a shell redirect, --out, cp/mv, sed -i) and the plan that alone lists a file it wrote — nothing when it claimed none, e.g. it edited only files several plans share; every open plan when the payload carries no readable agent transcript — blocks only on an unexplained colour literal, an unanchored visible design node or (web profiles) no data-dt-node tag at all, never writes plan.status, and stops itself at 60 s — the timeout below is the harness's backstop.
